title: Robust Audio Synchronization Under Extreme Time Warping
description: Alignment algorithms under severe global distortion done at Harvey Mudd
details: 93.7% alignment accuracy under 4x time warping — 31% improvement over DTW baselines. Sub-20ms latency at 44.1kHz sample rate. Evaluated across 2,400 audio pairs with synthetic and real-world distortions.

title: One-Shot Timbre Transfer with Mamba
description: Adaptive instance normalization with state-space models for music generation
details: 4.2x faster inference than transformer baselines. FAD score of 1.83 on unseen instruments — state-of-the-art for one-shot transfer. 12M parameters, trained on 800 hours of multi-instrument audio.

title: Training Action-Conditioned World Models
description: Learning environment dynamics from agent interactions for model-based planning
details: World model conditioned on agent actions to predict future states. Enables model-based planning with 3.2x sample efficiency over model-free baselines on DMControl benchmarks.

title: Correcting a Power-of-Two Quantization Error
description: Found and fixed a mathematical flaw in a widely adopted rounding scheme
details: Identified systematic bias affecting widely used INT8 quantization formula. Fix recovers 0.4–1.2% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet without retraining. Patch adopted upstream.

title: Computational Intensity of DNN Training Across GPUs
description: Profiling computation and memory bandwidth bottlenecks at scale
details: Profiled 14 model architectures across A100, H100, and RTX 4090. Identified 37% average memory bandwidth underutilization. Proposed operator fusion strategy yielding 3.4x throughput.

title: Diffusion Transformers for Architectural Floor Plans
description: Generative layout synthesis in collaboration with Creative Machines Lab
details: Generative model conditioned on spatial constraints via FiLM. Generates structurally valid floor plans with 91% constraint satisfaction. Trained on 45K annotated layouts.
